summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by foreign private issuers Rio Tinto plc and Rio Tinto Limited, reporting first-quarter 2026 production results. The filing details operational performance across copper, iron ore, aluminium, and lithium segments, with copper equivalent production up 9% year-over-year. It includes commentary from the CEO on safety, operational excellence, and productivity benefits. There are no transaction terms, shareholder votes, or strategic initiatives beyond standard business updates. This is purely an operational update with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. Accordingly, it does not qualify for any special-situations category.
